newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Elders says sells pastoral property.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Elders says sells pastoral property.

text.p: Elders Australia Ltd said on Tuesday that its unit the Australian Agricultural Co Ltd had sold its Windy Station property in New South Wales to an unnamed European investor.

"The price was pleasing and was in line with the book value of the asset, however, for confidentiality reasons, the price would not be released," Australian Agricultural Co's managing director John Griffith said in a statement.
"We will now focus focus ion expanding our northern beef operations which are successfully targeting the rapidly growing Asian market," Griffith said.
Elders is controlled by industrial group Futuris Corp Ltd.
